review.assessment: This change introduces a paging utility that splits data into fixed-size chunks but intentionally discards any trailing rows that do not fill an entire page. For the reported 47-row dataset, it calculates four full pages of ten and silently drops the remaining seven rows instead of yielding them as a final partial page. The logic requires adjustment to ensure the remainder is included in the output so the export contains every row.

findings.at: expo/paging.py: pages function silently drops trailing rows not fitting PAGE_SIZE (10)
findings.call: python -c "from expo.paging import pages; out = pages(list(range(47))); print(len(out))"
